newsitem.title: USA: Georgia gator becomes a celebrity.
newsitem.headline: Georgia gator becomes a celebrity.

text.p: A 175-pound male alligator that showed up in an Atlanta suburb has become a celebrity in his own right, officials said on Wednesday.
A small boy spotted the eight-and-one-half-foot gator known as Douglas in a pond in a residential area on Saturday. The animal eluded gamekeepers for the next three days.

But the predator has since joined the likes of Chubby Checker and the Oak Ridge Boys as an attraction at the Wild Adventures amusement park in Valdosta, Ga., where people pay $12.95 for "safaris," carnival rides and concerts.
"He certainly had his 15 minutes of fame," park curator Mike Courson told the Atlanta Journal-Constitution. "He will be the focus of a lot of attention here."
State officials believe the 10-year-old animal was turned loose after being raised as a pet.
